capabilities: Edit equations in a MathLive widget below the LaTeX display block
Toggle MathLive display globally, per block, or inline before/after the source equation
Define macros and shortcuts available in MathLive widgets
Switch rendering between MathLive and the built-in MathJax
Assign a hotkey to toggle the MathLive block
extras: The README warns the plugin uses non-public Obsidian and CodeMirror APIs that may break after updates, and lists unfinished items such as input issues on tablet/phone and an experimental inline-widget focus path.
problem: Obsidian only edits math as raw LaTeX source with MathJax preview, with no visual/interactive equation input in the editor.
